title: DRPAY: Merchant Payments
shortDescription: Manage merchant payments, collections and transfers with DRPAY.
fullDescription:
DRPAY is a mobile workspace for registered merchants in the Philippines.

Use the app to:

- Review your PHP wallet balance and payment activity.
- Create payment links and hosted checkouts for your customers.
- Accept QRPH payments through the channels enabled for your merchant account.
- Send supported bank or e-wallet transfers and review available networks before confirming.
- Follow transaction status and receive merchant notifications.

Keep access in your control with an MPIN, email verification when signing in on a new device, and biometric sign-in where supported.

DRPAY is for registered merchants, not consumer banking. Available payment methods, transfer networks, fees, limits and settlement times depend on your account, selected institution and provider.
